name: Mike Chirilenco
bioIntro:
With over 15 years of experience in the business travel industry, Mike Chirilenco is the Founder and CEO of Flight-Experts, a U.S.-focused premium travel agency specializing in international Business and First Class travel.

Combining extensive industry expertise with a genuine passion for aviation, Mike founded Flight-Experts with a clear vision: to make premium air travel more accessible while delivering exceptional service, transparency, and personalized attention.

As a frequent international traveler, Mike personally experiences Business Class products across major global airlines, continuously evaluating cabin comfort, onboard service, and the overall passenger experience. This firsthand knowledge, combined with his professional background, gives him a unique perspective on what truly matters to premium travelers.
quote: “Premium travel isn't just about flying Business or First Class. It's about the confidence of knowing that someone knowledgeable, reliable, and genuinely committed to your journey is taking care of every detail.”
bioMore:
Under Mike's leadership, Flight-Experts has grown into an IATA-accredited travel agency and ASTA member, built around trust, expertise, and customer satisfaction.

Beyond his passion for aviation, Mike is dedicated to developing talented teams, embracing innovative technologies, and raising service standards across the travel industry. His long-term vision is to establish Flight-Experts as a trusted name in premium travel, where industry knowledge, competitive fares, and genuine human connection come together to create exceptional travel experiences.
